items.t: Amgen’s acquired Sjögren’s drug a Phase III hit
items.sum: Jefferies analysts say that, based on caveated cross-trial comparisons, dazodalipeb looks better efficacy-wise than Novartis’ registrational Sjögren's drug, ianalumab.

items.t: 45 ETFs Add to Amgen (AMGN) Holdings on Tuesday
items.sum: ETFs bought a net $66.8 million of Amgen stock on Tuesday, Nov. 10.

items.t: Argus Research Maintains Buy on Amgen, Raises Price Target to $515
items.sum: Argus Research analyst Jasper Hellweg maintains Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) with a Buy and raises the price target from $460 to $515.

items.t: Amgen (AMGN) Stock Looks Cheap Based On Future Cash Flow
items.sum: Amgen has delivered a powerful run in recent years. After that climb, the key question is whether the current share price is still in line with the cash the business can generate. With the stock now reflecting years of strong performance and fresh product momentum, attention turns to what its cash flows actually justify. items.t: Amgen Reports Phase 3 Dazodalibep Trial Meets Primary Endpoint in Sjögren’s Disease
items.sum: Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) announced that its investigational treatment dazodalibep met the primary endpoint in the Phase 3 OASIZ-301 clinical trial, demonstrating statistically significant reductions in systemic disease activity among patients with Sjögren’s disease compared with placebo.
